mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy, which reduces discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate above 10.0% signals an economic recession, causing immediate negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods when UNRATE exceeds 10.0%, 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate weak consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When both HOUST and RSAFS decline, 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in industrial production signals a supply shock, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the subsequent 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods of supply shock (INDPRO decline > 10% from prior month), 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in nonfarm payrolls signals a strengthening labor market, which supports consumer spending and drives positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when PAYEMS rises.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly GDP growth rate below 0.5% signals economic weakness, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods when GDPC1 is below 0.5%, 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation above 3.0% signals a high-inflation environment, prompting monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0%, 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in housing starts indicates strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when HOUST rises.
